list.title: Work Reports
list.description: Five kinds of work reports (process attributes snapshotted with each report, business time backfilled); work reports failing content validation are rejected with a reason and can be re-submitted after correction; select a row to verify / correct / revoke.
list.empty: No work reports under the current filters

detail.title: Work Report Detail & Verification
detail.description: Verify → ReportVerified (payload = the hours consumption contract); correction = a corrected version + reason (original untouched); revoke = reversal.

progress.title: Drawing × Operation Progress
progress.empty: No operation progress facts for this drawing number

verify.title: Pending Verification Queue
verify.description: GET /reports/pending-verification; verified reports are posted to the hours ledger (hours consumption contract); select a row to operate.
verify.remark-label: Verification remark (optional; used as the reason on revoke)
